title: Equivalent spring constant
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify the equivalent spring constant as the sum k1 + k2.

title: Period formula application
description: Essential: The final answer for the period must be T = 2π√(m/(k1 + k2)).

title: Phase for displacement 0.5A
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the phase angles (e.g., π/6 and 5π/6) corresponding to the displacement x = A/2.

title: Time interval calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the total time Δt the ball spends in the region from O to 0.5A within one period.

title: Probability definition
description: Important: The student must apply the given probability definition P = Δt / T correctly.

title: Final probability answer
description: Essential: The final probability must be given as 1/6 (or equivalent).

title: Incorrect spring combination
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly treats the springs as being in parallel or uses a different equivalent constant (e.g., 1/k = 1/k1 + 1/k2).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize significant sign errors in the restoring force or omission/incorrect use of units in the final period expression.

title: Symmetry or time reasoning
description: Optional: Award credit for recognizing symmetry in SHM or using alternative reasoning (e.g., velocity considerations) to find the time interval.
